posts.text: One thing many people don’t realise about the broking business — this regulation is good to protect interest of retail however it can be very easily misused by brokers , especially if they tie up with corrupt governent officials. They can create sister broker firms showing them as a separate entity to bypass this total market OI limit. Example IIFL has 5paisa. And genuine firms like zerodha can suffer because of it. but there should be some regulations / anti trust laws to protect this industry from monopolistic exploitation .
